set -u
mkdir -p /tmp/empty-home
trap 'cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events > /out/memory-events.txt; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak > /out/memory-peak.txt' EXIT
rustc -Vv > /out/rustc.txt
result=0
cargo test --locked --offline --all-features --lib certified_standalone -- --nocapture > /out/boundary.log 2>&1
status=$?
echo $status > /out/boundary.exit
if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then result=1; fi
if grep -q 'could not compile' /out/boundary.log; then exit 1; fi
cargo test --locked --offline --all-features --lib native_graph_producer -- --nocapture > /out/producer.log 2>&1
status=$?
echo $status > /out/producer.exit
if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then result=1; fi
if grep -q 'could not compile' /out/producer.log; then exit 1; fi
cargo test --locked --offline --all-features --lib native_graph -- --nocapture > /out/coregraph.log 2>&1
status=$?
echo $status > /out/coregraph.exit
if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then result=1; fi
if grep -q 'could not compile' /out/coregraph.log; then exit 1; fi
exit $result
